trustBoundaries: Browser archive bytes cross from Puppeteer's configured download source into an ephemeral CI runner before extraction.
The @lhci/cli dependency tree is development-only and is not included in the deployed application.
suppressions.reachability: The vulnerable extractor is only called while @puppeteer/browsers installs a downloaded browser. This repository's Lighthouse job uses the runner's existing Chrome and runs lhci autorun; it does not install a browser or accept an archive URL from product users.
suppressions.rationale: No patched extract-zip release exists. Exploitation would require the CI workflow to install a malicious browser archive, such as after compromise of the configured download source. The package is not imported by product code and cannot access production data or user requests.
invalidationConditions: @lhci/cli or Lighthouse upgrades to a Puppeteer browser dependency that removes extract-zip
CI starts installing browsers through Puppeteer
an untrusted input can control a browser archive, download base URL, or extraction path
extract-zip enters a production dependency path or is imported directly
